reference.note: A published index (average of 20 bunkering ports), not a port price. Retrieved 2026-10-11.

pricing.description: VLSFO spot indications for the five WorldSmall ports that Ship & Bunker publishes on its free price pages, plus the Global 20 Ports Average as the reference price. Latest row of each page on 2026-10-11 (page label 'F Oct 9'). The pages show weekday and month-day only; the year 2026 is inferred from the weekday (Friday 9 October is 2026) and the retrieval date. Only 5 of the 47 WorldSmall ports have an observation; every other rotation is priced at the reference (basis 'global_reference').
